$comment: Telemetry's reasons ([code, short]) and the sentences it says to a person, as data. The setup question, the notice and the hint are said only where an address is set.
codes: an environment switch is set in this process (DO_NOT_TRACK, ATLASBOUND_TELEMETRY=0 or CI)
this machine has no home directory for your user, so a choice cannot be stored; telemetry stays off
the stored choice could not be read; telemetry stays off until atlasbound telemetry on or off writes it again
no module of that name reports here; atlasbound telemetry status lists them
the phrase was not typed, so nothing was turned on
a new random id from the next report on
the next attempt is not due yet
another process is sending; this one leaves it
the reports left; the server answered for each
the server asked to wait; the next attempt honours it
the network or the server failed; retried at a later command
the server refused the request; it is not retried
this build has no address; nothing was dialled, the reports wait here (14 days)
the server deleted what your id sent
the server could not be reached: deletion pending, tried once a day for 14 days (it holds only the old random id and its deletion token)
this build sent nothing, so there is nothing to delete on a server
reports of your old id were received by an earlier build; this build cannot reach the service, the request waits
deletion could not be confirmed in 14 days; the server's copy expires 30 days after it was sent
a report did not pass its own schema and was not made
a trace line that does not read as ab-trace/1 was left out; the rest of its file counts
a package's telemetry descriptor does not read: it registers nothing
a package claims a namespace another package owns: it registers nothing
the descriptors of one namespace disagree on schema or policy: none registers
two steps of one namespace would leave as one word: none registers
a metric is named twice in one namespace: none registers
only https, or http on this machine, may be dialled

texts.question: Send a daily usage report during the beta? It goes to telemetry.atlasbound.dev, run by AtlasBound, to find the product's faults and slow steps.
texts.notice: Telemetry is on during the beta (until {until}): a daily usage report goes to telemetry.atlasbound.dev, run by AtlasBound, to find the product's faults and slow steps.
sent: Sent: which AtlasBound steps ran, how often, how long (in ranges) and their outcome codes; sizes in ranges (decisions and open points per plan, time and turns until a plan is READY, lines and messages of a handoff note, answers not recorded at stop);
the version, Node major and OS family; a random id that changes every 30 days.
Never sent: your code, prompts, answers, file or repository names, paths, error texts.
texts.kept: Kept 30 days per id, then only monthly totals for 13 months. See it: atlasbound telemetry next · Stop: atlasbound telemetry off · Delete: atlasbound telemetry reset --forget
texts.yesAgain: Please answer y or n [Y/n] (Enter = yes)
texts.unchosen: Telemetry: no choice was recorded (the answer was neither y nor n). A person chooses later: atlasbound telemetry on | off
texts.hint: Telemetry is not on. A person can turn it on: atlasbound telemetry on · what it is: atlasbound telemetry status
texts.goes: goes to: {url}, once a day, from a command you or your AI session runs; never from a hook
texts.noAddress: this build has no address: nothing is sent, whatever is chosen. Reports you turn on are made and kept here only (atlasbound telemetry next | history); a release that can send tells you at setup before anything leaves.
texts.onEmpty: This build has no address to send to. Turning it on makes the daily reports here so you can read them; nothing leaves.
texts.see: see: atlasbound telemetry next | history · stop: atlasbound telemetry off · delete: atlasbound telemetry reset --forget
texts.forgetWaits: a deletion request waits for the server ({n}); atlasbound telemetry status says when it is done
texts.wouldPost: the next attempt would post {bytes} bytes, exactly (nothing was sent by this command):
texts.staysHere: stays here: the trace, your choice and the period's deletion token; reports already received or refused (atlasbound telemetry history)
